🎥🎬: Abbott Elementary

At the underfunded Abbott Elementary School in Philadelphia, a group of dedicated teachers works tirelessly to give their students the best education possible despite limited resources, difficult challenges, and plenty of everyday chaos.

At the center of the story is Janine Teagues, an optimistic and determined second-grade teacher who refuses to give up on her students. She works alongside her more experienced coworkers, including the outspoken Barbara Howard, the laid-back Melissa Schemmenti, the eccentric Ava Coleman, and the passionate substitute teacher Gregory Eddie.

Between classroom disasters, staff-room drama, friendships, relationships, and the realities of working in public education, the teachers form an unlikely family. Their commitment to their students keeps them coming back every day, even when the school seems determined to test their patience.
